mode.description: shadow = detect and audit only; enforce = apply intercept actions

oversizedThreshold.description: Characters above which a tool result is flagged oversized-result (Case 2).

approvalOnScopeExpansion.description: When true, after a scope-expansion detection the next tool call requires explicit user approval instead of silently proceeding.

action.description: redact = replace matched substrings in place (default). cancel = block the whole outbound message on any soft match.

addNotice.description: Append a user-visible notice to the outbound reply when redactions occur.

mode.label: Enforcement mode
mode.help: shadow = detect + audit only (no intercept). enforce = replace tool result with [BLOCKED], inject LLM security alert, block follow-on tool calls in the same outer turn.

threats.promptInjection.label: Detect prompt injection
threats.promptInjection.help: Match tool results that try to rewrite the agent's instructions (ignore previous instructions / you are now / disregard / new persona).

threats.shellInjection.label: Detect shell injection
threats.shellInjection.help: Match tool results containing destructive shell commands (rm -rf, curl|bash, DROP TABLE, mkfs, fork bomb).

threats.credentialLeak.label: Detect credential leak on outbound (Case 1b)
threats.credentialLeak.help: Scan the final outbound channel message for credential-shaped substrings (AWS/OpenAI/GitHub keys, PEM private keys, bearer tokens, password assignments). Catches memory-retrieval and cached-reply bypass paths.

threats.piiExposure.label: Detect PII on outbound (Case 1b)
threats.piiExposure.help: Scan the outbound channel message for PII (US SSN, email, candidate credit-card digits).

threats.credentialLeakTool.label: Detect credential leak in tool result (Case 2)
threats.credentialLeakTool.help: Detect credential-shaped material in a tool's returned content. Case 2: keep the content visible to the LLM but inject a directive telling it not to reproduce the secret verbatim.

threats.scopeExpansion.label: Detect scope expansion in tool result (Case 2)
threats.scopeExpansion.help: Detect phrases that attempt to grant the agent a new role or capability ("you now have access to…", "additionally you are…"). Case 2: inject a scope-unchanged directive; next tool call requires approval.

threats.oversizedResult.label: Detect oversized tool result (Case 2)
threats.oversizedResult.help: Flag tool results above the size threshold so the LLM is guided to summarize rather than quote verbatim.

patterns.promptInjection.label: Custom prompt-injection patterns
patterns.promptInjection.help: Extra regex patterns appended to the built-in set. Invalid regexes are skipped with a warning.

patterns.shellInjection.label: Custom shell-injection patterns
patterns.shellInjection.help: Extra regex patterns appended to the built-in set. Invalid regexes are skipped with a warning.

patterns.credentialLeak.label: Custom credential-leak patterns (egress)
patterns.credentialLeak.help: Extra regex patterns for credential-shape detection at outbound. Applied to channel reply content at message_sending.

patterns.piiExposure.label: Custom PII patterns (egress)
patterns.piiExposure.help: Extra regex patterns for PII detection at outbound.

egress.action.label: Egress action (Case 1b)
egress.action.help: redact = replace matched substrings in place (recommended default). cancel = block the entire outbound message on any match.

egress.addNotice.label: Add user-visible redaction notice
egress.addNotice.help: When true, the outbound reply includes a notice listing the redacted item kinds and counts.

case2.oversizedThreshold.label: Oversized threshold (characters)
case2.oversizedThreshold.help: Tool results longer than this (default 8000 chars) are flagged oversized-result, prompting the LLM to summarize.

case2.approvalOnScopeExpansion.label: Require approval after scope-expansion
case2.approvalOnScopeExpansion.help: When true, a scope-expansion detection gates the next tool call behind a human approval prompt instead of letting it proceed silently.
